items.description: Geograph photos placed on a British map. Built with the Ordnance Survey OpenSpace API.
Localmouth aggregates local information for places in the UK. It provides events, property, jobs, news and other listings relevant to a given village, town or suburb.
Zipments is a community of couriers that will deliver items when and where you need them, including items from your favorite local merchants. Uses the Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Add My Pet Profile from MatchMyPet.com to your iGoogle page.
Honeygain is a mobile application in which users can earn money by allowing application access to user behavior. Simply download the app, turn it on, and earn!
PhoneCo.in enables anyone with a cell phone to send and receive bitcoins. Simple, mobile, point-of-sale bitcoin transactions are as easy as sending a text message.
Webcams around the world with Google Maps.
Loc Amigos helps you find your friends all over the web. It will match up friends in your address books with their profiles across lots of social networking sites like MySpace, Flickr, and others.
TextFlow works with Box.net's version history to provide advanced version comparison of all file changes from you and your collaborators.
Online Alternative Trading System (ATS) with Paypal Express Checkout API. Available on sourceforge.
Discover Music you like using tag cloud of similar artists inclusing videoclips. Powered by Google Java App Engine.
The site mashes up San Francisco public-school and marijuana-dispensary data. The map shows walking distances from each public school to the nearest marijuana dispensary and vice versa.
